name: Sakurako
source:
Birth year: 1968

Main character of "1985-1994 scenario"
[url=/c92780]Souji[/url]'s close friend. [url=/c92781]Akisumi[/url]'s girlfriend. [spoiler][url=/c92847]Sumire[/url]'s mother.[/spoiler]
A girl who is keen on raising flowers, believing that they will save the world from any disasters. Despite her assertive personality, she could be pretty childish at times. [spoiler]Similar to [url=/c92780]Souji[/url], Sakurako also possesses the ability to perceive "irregular" matters.[/spoiler]
Later on, [spoiler]Sakurako becomes pregnant with [url=/c92781]Akisumi[/url]'s child and conceives [url=/c92847]Sumire[/url] afterward. Her death is revealed on 22 Mar 1995, due to an accident in the laboratory that she is working for.[/spoiler]
